extractor_notes.blockers: BullFrog AI is an AI/ML drug-discovery platform company, not a clinical-stage therapeutics developer. The latest 5 8-Ks cover Nasdaq listing compliance (stockholders' equity rule, minimum bid price), an at-the-market sales facility, and a commercial agreement with a top-5 global pharma for use of its bfLEAP platform. No clinical trial milestones, PDUFAs, INDs, or data readouts for any internal therapeutic asset.
extractor_notes.tier0_overlap_check: Tier0 also unlikely to surface clinical catalysts for BFRG; this is not a typical biotech pipeline issuer.
